items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 1 at 2:51PM EST until November 3 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 knots with gusts up to 25 knots and
seas 5 to 8 feet.

* WHERE...Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm
and Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM EST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 1 at 4:45PM EST until November 1 at 5:45PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm...
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm...

* Until 545 PM EST.

* At 445 PM EST, strong thunderstorms were located along a line from
over Saint Lucie West to 28 NM northeast of Hobe Sound Beach, or
along a line from near Port Saint Lucie to 28 NM east of Saint
Lucie Nuclear Power Plant, moving northwest at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Frederick Douglass Park, Fort Pierce Ocean Park, Surfside Park,
Fort Pierce Inlet, Pepper Beach Park, Saint Lucie Nuclear Power
Plant, Queens Cove, Hutchinson Island South, Fort Pierce, Nettles
Island, Moorings Of Vero Beach, Saint Lucie Village, Saint Lucie,
Indian River Estates, Waveland, Floralton Beach, Walton, Indrio,
South Beach and Fort Pierce North.
items.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
Wind gusts 34 knots or greater, high waves, dangerous lightning, and
heavy rain are possible with these storms.
